cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stand by that open window. I'm checking whether my team responds to a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing there. Why can't I stay at my desk?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll keep it comfortable. Stand on whichever side has less draft; I just need to see you follow the instruction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm getting my coat before I stand anywhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, sensible preparation. Fetch mine too and hold it while I finish checking the team. You choose which arm; I want willing cooperation, not cold fingers.

reason: Have the authority test adapt to B warmth boundary while expanding into extra coat service, keeping the inconvenience and dependence both visible.
